source_text.ISS-0936: Issue ISS-0936 (local record docs/issues/ISS-0936.yaml, queue_ref Q-919, queue task 919, GH#2070; record may not yet be on this branch - PR #2071): scripts/uat_preflight.sh's qa-uat-env credential protocol (fetch_credential, ~line 290) expects the credential source's `token <user>` to print a line `Token: <jwt>`, but ai-dala-infra's qa-uat-env.sh `token <user>` prints a BARE JWT, so every actor login reports NO_PASSWORD. Fix: make fetch_credential accept a bare JWT line (three dot-separated base64url segments) as well as the `Token:` form. Add/adjust tests per project's existing preflight tests (none found under test/ -- TEST-DESIGNER decides a minimal in-repo test shape). Also update the script's header docs (qa-uat-env protocol paragraph) and scripts/README.md if they state the Token: form.

task.description: WF-03 Step 4: write the regression test per the validated design section 6 (lib/letflow/design/iss0936-uat-preflight-bare-jwt.md): test/scripts/uat_preflight_bare_jwt_test.exs (ExUnit, T1-T7 with the pinned flags/substrings, run_preflight/2 helper, hermetic --idp-url) plus a test spec test/specs/ISS-0936.md. FAIL-FIRST proof is mandatory: run the tests against the PRE-FIX script (use a throwaway `git worktree` from origin/main, or copy `git show origin/main:scripts/uat_preflight.sh` into a temp path and point the test at it via an env var/param only if the design allows -- preferred: throwaway worktree of origin/main plus your new test file) and record which tests fail; then run on the fix branch and record pass. Additionally mutate the fix (e.g. drop the eyJ prefix requirement so hostnames pass; drop bare-JWT acceptance; print token) in a THROWAWAY worktree only and record which tests fail per mutant; remove worktrees after. Make sure the main fix worktree lib/ scripts/ stay unmutated (quote `git status --porcelain scripts/ lib/` at end: only expected diffs). Elixir toolchain: see docs/anti-patterns.md Docker fallback if mix is not installed locally; if you truly cannot run mix test, say so explicitly and run the equivalent otherwise. Use Git Bash via UAT_PF_BASH on this Windows host. Do not commit or push.
